name: KYC - Controlled Quality Output
description: Governed KYC assessment for corporate banking: specialist agents produce credit and compliance findings, then a non-bypassable governance layer applies deterministic financial checks, sanctions/PEP screening, a three-layer policy cascade (ORG/APP/REQUEST), and an LLM-as-Judge quality score to reach the final APPROVE/ESCALATE/DECLINE/BLOCK decision. Ships a two-mode console: a guided Basic-mode walkthrough and a full governance console (Advanced) with CRO fleet, evaluations, and earned-autonomy views.

frameworks.name: LangGraph
frameworks.description: Default implementation: LangGraph state graph (router -> parallel specialists -> synthesize -> governance_review)

deployment_patterns.name: Terraform + CloudFormation
deployment_patterns.description: Self-contained AgentCore runtime (Terraform infra + runtime + UI) plus CloudFormation stacks for the governance microservices and console services

parameters.name: project_name
parameters.description: Short resource-name prefix. Keep it short: it is composed into IAM role names as AgentCoreRuntime-<project_name>-<use_case>-<framework>-<region>, which AWS caps at 64 characters. 'ava' also matches the prefix recorded in this use case's existing Terraform state, so a deploy converges on the running deployment instead of creating a parallel one.

parameters.name: governance_mode
parameters.description: external = the deployed governance services are authoritative and failures fail closed; local = in-process equivalents for standalone/dev runs

parameters.name: governance_ssm_prefix
parameters.description: SSM path prefix the governance stacks publish their Lambda function names to (e.g. /kyc-gov/demo). The runtime resolves the 5 function names from here and invokes them directly with IAM auth, so there is no public endpoint and no account-specific value is committed.

example_use_cases: Corporate onboarding KYC with a non-bypassable governance layer over agent output
Demonstrating deterministic controls (recomputed ratios, sanctions/PEP screening, policy cascade) that override an LLM verdict
Earned-autonomy governance: promotion and automatic demotion driven by measured accuracy
author: AVA Team

outputs.cloudfront_url: CloudFront distribution URL serving the governance console
outputs.agentcore_runtime_arn: AgentCore Runtime ARN for the KYC assessment agent
outputs.console_gateway_endpoint: Consolidated console-services gateway fronted by CloudFront /svc/*
